result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but horizontal content is clipped on the right and a loading indicator is visibly obscuring a restaurant image.

issues.description: The horizontal category row is cut off at the right edge, leaving a partial pill visible with no clear indication that the row can scroll.
issues.suggestion: Add intentional end spacing and a visible scroll affordance (such as a faded edge or partial next item positioned cleanly), or ensure the row content fits within the viewport.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is clipped on the right, including its restaurant name and delivery details, which makes the content look truncated.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearly designed horizontal carousel with consistent peek width and sufficient text-safe card sizing, or prevent text from rendering until the full card is visible.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is centered over the “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” image, obscuring the food image and appearing stuck in the rendered state.
issues.suggestion: Replace the spinner with a skeleton/loading state before content is shown, and remove it immediately once the restaurant image has loaded.

issues.description: The second “Popular right now” restaurant card is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation, making its image and content appear abruptly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the fixed navigation height so the final visible card can scroll fully above the navigation.
